name: Best Buy's Youth Tech Day 2024
description: Best Buy Canada's Youth Tech Day brings STEM to life for kids aged 10–16 through free, hands-on workshops at Vancouver's Robson Square, from robotics to digital music. The 2024 event brought Geek Squad Academy and big names like Microsoft and Nintendo to the floor.

modules.content:
CHALLENGE

How do you make Geek Squad the most recognizable presence in a room full of big brands?

SOLUTION

Following the Geek Squad spec sheet, the brand was applied across flag banners, tabletop displays, floor wayfinding, and roll-up banners. Every format told the same visual story, making Geek Squad impossible to miss no matter where kids turned.
